annotations.title: Set the sites a routine can reach

description: Sets the full list of sites a routine's machine may reach on each run (example.com, or *.example.com for its subdomains; up to 20), for a routine that has to use a site like a person would because read_webpage can't get it. It replaces the list, so read routines_list first (allowedSites) and pass every site to keep. Always waits for approval, and only a workspace admin's approval applies it; for anyone else it says who can. The next run reaches the new list.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

sites.description: Every site the routine may reach.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: routines_set_sites
